rationale: For an outdoor professional surveying app like SmartGNSS, direct sunlight readability is critical. We use extreme high-contrast (Swiss style), large bold touch targets, and mono fonts for coordinate data. The interface must prioritize function, scanability, and precision over decorative elements.

spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: Minimum 48px (h-12 or p-4) for gloved fingers
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-md (subtle, crisp 6px radius for technical feel)
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid border-border (crisp grid lines to separate data clearly)

status_bar.description: Always visible top bar with tight layout.
status_bar.content: GNSS Fix Status (colored badge), Satellite count, Battery %, HRMS/VRMS accuracy in cm.
status_bar.classes: flex items-center justify-between p-2 bg-black text-white text-xs font-mono

home_dashboard.tile_style: flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm active:bg-gray-100

bottom_navigation.classes: fixed bottom-0 w-full flex justify-around items-center bg-white border-t border-gray-300 h-16 pb-safe

survey_screen.coordinate_display: grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-sm font-mono border border-gray-200 p-2 rounded bg-gray-50
survey_screen.action_button: w-full bg-primary text-white h-16 text-xl font-bold rounded-md flex items-center justify-center active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform

stakeout_screen.layout: Target bullseye compass top, guidance metrics bottom
stakeout_screen.bullseye: aspect-square w-full max-w-xs mx-auto rounded-full border-4 border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-center relative
stakeout_screen.metrics: text-center space-y-2 font-mono text-3xl font-black text-primary

data_table.description: Dense points list with sticky header.
data_table.row_style: flex border-b border-gray-200 p-2 text-sm font-mono items-center
data_table.header_style: flex bg-gray-100 border-b-2 border-black p-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal ambient shadows (shadow-sm). Rely on borders for definition.
visual_enhancers.textures: None. Needs to be crisp and high contrast.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (Duotone or Bold) for high legibility.

survey_equipment.description: Tripod on green grass field, useful for onboarding or empty states

map_backgrounds.description: Topography map texture for project placeholder imagery

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first hybrid dashboard application focusing on outdoor readability.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the high-level layout, but build it like an app (fixed headers, bottom tabs, scrollable content areas).
Ensure all interactive elements have at least 48px height/width touch targets.
Mock the GNSS Status (Fixed/Float/Single) and update it periodically or via a toggle to demonstrate state changes.
Mock the Bluetooth device connection state.
Use Phosphor Icons to represent the primary tools.
Coordinate values must always use the IBM Plex Mono font.
